bookmark_add.description: Add a bookmark that goes to a page, under a parent bookmark (or at the top level), at a position. Undoable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

parent.description: Parent bookmark (omit for the top level): 1-based positions from the top level, e.g. [2, 1] = the first child of the second bookmark.

position.description: 1-based position among the parent's children (default: last).

bookmark_add.name: bookmark_add

bookmark_list.description: The bookmarks in outline order, one page at a time: each with its path (1-based, as the other bookmark tools take it), title, target page and open state, and its children on the same page. next is the offset of the following page, or null at the end. Bookmarks nested deeper than 33 levels are not listed.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

offset.description: Where the page starts, counted from 0 (the previous page's next)

doc_open.description: Open a PDF file and return its document id, page count and whether it can be edited.

password.description: User or owner password for encrypted files.

doc_open.name: doc_open

doc_save.description: Save to its own file (an incremental update, which keeps signatures valid) or to a new path (a full rewrite). The write is atomic. flatten_fill_sign bakes Fill & Sign text, marks and signatures into the page first and removes those annotations; other comments and form fields stay. Omit it, or pass false, to leave them editable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

flatten_fill_sign.description: Bake Fill & Sign marks into the page before writing. Default false.

full.description: Force a full rewrite (or, with false, an incremental update).

path.description: Save as this file. Omit to save in place.

doc_save.name: doc_save
